newsitem.title: UK: LME copper ends PM kerb robust, but off peak.
newsitem.headline: LME copper ends PM kerb robust, but off peak.

text.p: COPPER - Ends PM kerb with healthy gains above $2,460, but off high. Cash/threes backwardation slips back below $100, ends at $90/$95. NICKEL - Firmer, under $7,800.
ALUMINIUM - Gives up gains after heavy forward selling came in. ZINC - Also off highs, ends touch higher.
LEAD - Barely firmer. TIN - Stuck in range.
